hook.name: RebelProtocol
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH/USDT/USDC↔REBEL pools that charges a fixed 1% fee on every swap (always denominated in non-REBEL currency) using beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns. Fees fund a round-based PvP game where buyers compete to become "King" and earn from a leaderboard-weighted stake pool; no admin, no upgrade, no owner.
